functions.description: Parse base syslog structure: timestamp, host, process id, event id, and message text
Extract user, realm, source IP, and target LDAP server for authentication success/failure events

conf.regex: /for user '(?<user>[^']+)' at realm '(?<realm>[^']+)' from IPv?6? (?<src_ip>[0-9a-fA-F:.]+), server '(?<dst_host>[^:']+):(?<dst_port>\d+)'/

functions.description: Fallback extraction of source IP for events not matching the primary auth pattern (locked account, anonymous bind, brute force, injection)
Fallback extraction of target LDAP server host and port for bind failures, certificate errors, search timeouts, and bind successes
Derive normalized action, severity, protocol, and _time fields from message content

add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/authentication successful/) ? 'success' : message.match(/authentication failed/) ? 'failure' : message.match(/bind failed/) ? 'failure' : message.match(/bind successful/) ? 'success' : message.match(/account locked/) ? 'locked' : message.match(/rejected/) ? 'rejected' : message.match(/injection detected/) ? 'blocked' : message.match(/certificate validation failed/) ? 'failure' : message.match(/search timeout/) ? 'timeout' : message.match(/search operation completed/) ? 'success' : message.match(/password expired/) ? 'notification' : 'unknown'
